title: Reflect closing call
description: The closing call: a centred badge, gradient heading, one-line lead and a violet button in a field of slowly turning stars, over a bright violet glow rising from the section's floor like a sunrise. The glow fades in as it enters the window.
notes: media is the 16:9 light effect (a looping video in the original), anchored to the bottom edge; empty, a bright glow wash
